JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Welcome to the Orange Islands
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Meet Professor Ivy on Valencia Island, then sail to Mikan Island for your first Orange Crew badge.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Orange Crew
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Win the Coral-Eye, Sea Ruby, Spike Shell and Jade Star Badges from Cissy, Danny, Rudy and Luana.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Orange League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Beat Drake's full six-Pokemon team at Pummelo Stadium to win the Winner's Trophy.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Pink Pokemon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Stop Team Rocket on Pinkan Island and earn Officer Jenny's permit to catch Pinkan Pokemon.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Crystal Onix
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Mateo on Sunburst Island says a glass-clear Onix lives in the Crystal Cave.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Chosen One
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Gather the treasures of Fire, Ice and Lightning Islands and bring them to the Shamouti Shrine.

lines: Professor Ivy: Welcome to Valencia Island! I study how Pokemon here differ from other regions.
Some have new colors, some grow bigger. You'll see on your journey!
One favor: I found this strange ball, and nobody can open it.
If you ever go to Johto, Kurt in Azalea Town knows Poke Balls better than anyone.
done: Professor Ivy: The four Orange Crew Gyms are on Mikan, Navel, Trovita and Kumquat.
Win all four badges, then challenge Drake at Pummelo Stadium!

lines: A young Lapras is stranded in the shallows, crying for its herd.
You stay with it all afternoon. It doesn't want to leave your side!

travel_options.message: The ship sails across the whole archipelago to Pummelo Island.

intro: Tracey: Oh! A trainer! I'm sketching Pokemon here. Want to battle while I watch?
player_won: Tracey: Wow, nice! I'll draw that battle later.

lines: {rival_name}: You're the Orange League Champion now. One more, for real!

intro: {rival_name}: You're the Orange League Champion now. One more, for real!
{rival_name}: You're Ivy's new trainer? Let's see if you're worth it.
Cissy: I'm Cissy of the Orange Crew. Seadra and Blastoise, let's go!
player_won: Cissy: What a splash! The Coral-Eye Badge is yours.
player_lost: Cissy: Better work on that aim. Come back any time!

lines: Mateo: Welcome to Sunburst Island, the island of glass!
A Crystal Onix lives in the cave by the lake. Its body is clear as glass.
Water and Electric attacks pass right through it. Only fire can crack it.
If you can calm it down, come back. I'll make you something special.
done: Mateo: The Crystal Onix is in the cave by the lake. Good luck!

lines: Mateo: You calmed the Crystal Onix! I've never seen glass shine like that.
I made this glass coin from sand by the lake. It's said to bring good fortune!
And this Crystal Stone: an Onix that touches it turns to living crystal, like the one in the cave!

intro: Butch: The name's BUTCH! This underground lab is Team Rocket business!
Cassidy: You beat Butch? Then I'll handle you myself!

lines: Officer Jenny: Pinkan Island is a protected reserve.
The Pinkan Berries here turn the Pokemon pink! Poachers want them badly.
Team Rocket was spotted in the reserve. Please, stop them!
done: Officer Jenny: Team Rocket is somewhere in the reserve. Be careful!

lines: Officer Jenny: You chased off Team Rocket! The reserve is safe again.
Here's a research permit. You may catch Pinkan Pokemon to study them.
Treat them kindly. They only turn pink thanks to the berries here!

fail: Strange footprints lead into the berry trees...
lines: Jessie and James are stuffing Pinkan Berries into sacks!
Team Rocket: Pink Pokemon will make us rich! Out of our way!

player_won: Team Rocket: We're blasting off again!

intro: Tracey: I'm a Pokemon Watcher now! Let me test my team on you!
Danny's challenge starts at the bottom of the volcano!
It's freezing at the top. Can your Pokemon take it?
Danny: You made it up the mountain. Now for a three-on-three battle!
player_won: Danny: Great battle! Take the Sea Ruby Badge.
player_lost: Danny: Not bad! Climb back up when you're ready.

requirements.fail_text: Danny only battles trainers with the Coral-Eye Badge.

intro: {rival_name}: Climbing to Danny's challenge? I'm going first.
Jessie: Prepare for trouble! James: Make it double! Golden Island's treasure is ours!
{rival_name}: Two badges? I've got two too. Battle!
Tracey: Scyther and I trained hard. Ready?
player_won: Tracey: You'll win the Orange League for sure!

travel_options.message: The ferry crosses to Trovita Island. Rudy's Gym stands by the beach.

intro: Jessie: The mayor's office is ours now! James: And so is the city!

travel_options.message: The ship sails back to Trovitopolis.

intro: Rudy: Welcome to Trovita! My Pokemon and I battle with style.
player_won: Rudy: Brilliant! The Spike Shell Badge suits you.
player_lost: Rudy: Better luck next time. The ferry will bring you back!

requirements.fail_text: Rudy only battles trainers with two Orange Crew badges.

intro: {rival_name}: Three badges. Let's see who reaches Drake first.
Luana's son Travis runs the hotel. I run this battle!
Two Pokemon at once? That's how we battle on Kumquat.
Luana: Alakazam and Marowak work as one. Can your team keep up?
player_won: Luana: Wonderful teamwork! You've earned the Jade Star Badge.
Now you may challenge Drake at Pummelo Stadium.
player_lost: Luana: Teamwork takes practice. Come back soon!

requirements.fail_text: Luana only battles trainers with three Orange Crew badges.

travel_options.message: The ship sails north to Shamouti Island, where a festival is starting.
The ship sails back to Valencia Island.

intro: Drake: I'm Drake, Supreme Gym Leader of the Orange League.
Nobody has beaten my six Pokemon in a full battle. Show me what you've got!
player_won: Drake: Incredible... My Dragonite has finally met its match.
The Winner's Trophy is yours, Orange League Champion!
player_lost: Drake: A good battle, but the trophy stays here. Train and come back!

requirements.fail_text: Only trainers with all four Orange Crew badges may challenge Drake.

intro: {rival_name}: Before you face Drake, you face me!

lines: Melody: Welcome to the festival! Have you heard our island's legend?
Three titans of fire, ice and lightning must never fight.
If they do, only the guardian of the sea can stop them, and it needs help.
The legend says a Chosen One will gather a treasure from each titan's island.
You came by sea on festival day... I think you're the Chosen One!
Bring the three treasures to the Shrine, and the guardian will sing.
done: Melody: Fire Island, Ice Island, Lightning Island. Then the Shrine!

travel_options.message: The ship sails back to Pummelo Island.

boss.name: Moltres
lines: Moltres guards the island's shrine, crackling with power!
won: Moltres settles down and flies off.
In the shrine you find the Fire Treasure!

lines: You search Fire Island's shrine again...
There it is: the Fire Treasure, glowing on the altar!

boss.name: Articuno
lines: Articuno guards the island's shrine, crackling with power!
won: Articuno settles down and flies off.
In the shrine you find the Ice Treasure!

lines: You search Ice Island's shrine again...
There it is: the Ice Treasure, glowing on the altar!

intro: Lawrence III: A collector of rare Pokemon, and you're in my way. Moltres is already mine!

boss.name: Zapdos
lines: Zapdos guards the island's shrine, crackling with power!
won: Zapdos settles down and flies off.
In the shrine you find the Lightning Treasure!

lines: You search Lightning Island's shrine again...
There it is: the Lightning Treasure, glowing on the altar!

fail: Three empty spots on the shrine's altar are shaped like treasures...
lines: You place the three treasures on the altar. They glow brightly!
Slowking: The titans are calm. Listen... the guardian of the sea is singing.
Something enormous is rising from the waves!
